text.name: fp_logWeightEnabledTT
text.text: Newly cut logs get the weight of fresh, wet wood.

text.name: fp_logWeightScaleTT
text.text: 100 % = realistic green wood density. Lower it if machines reach their limits too quickly.

text.name: fp_logWeightMaxFactorTT
text.text: A log never gets heavier than this times its base game weight.

text.name: fp_grabEnabledTT
text.text: Stronger claws and a firmer hold of the log in the grapple.

text.name: fp_clawStrengthTT
text.text: Holding force of the claws. Applied to grapples as soon as they are empty.

text.name: fp_mountStiffnessTT
text.text: How firmly the log sits in the grapple (also grows with the weight). Applied from the next grab.

text.name: fp_maxWobbleDegTT
text.text: How far the log may tilt in the grapple. Applied from the next grab.

text.name: fp_lockTranslationTT
text.text: Logs no longer slide freely in grapples without locked axes.
